palette: Coral pink, abyssal blue, ivory highlights, golden eyes; amber on mythical claws and forehead.
concept: Anomalocaris del océano primitivo, con apéndices frontales espinosos, ojos sobre tallos y aletas laterales.
design: ANOMALOCARIS prehistoric swimming arthropod, not a lobster/crab/shrimp. Broad elongated segmented body with MANY broad lateral swimming flaps, exactly TWO spiny curled raking frontal appendages under head, TWO short eye stalks with large golden eyes, small circular underside mouth, rear fan tail. NO walking legs, giant lobster pincers, long antennae, shells or horns. BASE tiny rounded coral pink larva, two small rolled front hooks, large innocent golden stalk eyes and short blue side flaps. EVO1 longer coral segmented body, more side flaps, slightly spiny hooks. EVO2 fierce ancient swimmer with wide dark blue/pink lateral flaps, two great spiny raking hooks and large tail fan. MYTHICAL sacred guardian of first ocean: huge majestic Anomalocaris with spectacular layered pale coral/blue sail-like flaps rendered flat opaque pixels, two enormous hooks bearing integrated amber rings, golden forehead angular rune marking and big golden stalk eyes. Preserve stalk eyes, two hook appendages and broad lateral flap body through all stages. Swimming in transparent empty space, no bubbles/aura.

palette: Iridescent green, electric cobalt/cyan, ivory wing facets, gold and amber accents.
concept: Libélula gigante cuyas cuatro alas de vitral canalizan las tormentas y llevan las marcas de ámbar del Cronoportal.
design: MEGANEURA prehistoric GIANT DRAGONFLY family. Exactly SIX thin insect legs, huge paired compound eyes, elongated segmented abdomen and exactly FOUR membranous wings (two matching pairs). Not butterfly, moth, mantis, beetle or bird. BASE cute chubby aquatic dragonfly nymph with short segmented jade abdomen, six little legs, huge gentle blue eyes and two pairs tiny folded wing buds, no adult wings yet. EVO1 young dragonfly with four SHORT clear angular pale-blue wings, jade head and bright cobalt compound eyes, longer tail. EVO2 fierce giant dragonfly, very long blue/green segmented abdomen, six legs, four great outspread membranous wings with electric blue vein facets. MYTHICAL time-storm guardian: spectacular enormous Meganeura with FOUR long stained-glass-style wings built from broad cyan/ivory/green facets, integrated amber vein runes, huge fierce blue compound eyes, long emerald/gold abdomen and SIX legs. A few tiny detached hard gold spark pixels only, no filled halo. Preserve huge blue eyes, green segmented thorax and four-wing structure. Fully show all four wings separately in front/back views.

palette: Moss green body, terracotta/orange leaf plates, ivory and golden amber tail spikes.
concept: Stegosaurus de placas vegetales y púas de ámbar que protege las manadas del Jurásico.
design: STEGOSAURUS prehistoric plant guardian. Clear low small beaked dinosaur head, big arched quadruped torso, TWO staggered rows of large triangular DORSAL PLATES, four thick legs with hindlegs taller than forelegs, long strong tail with tail spike pairs. Not an armadillo/turtle or fin-backed Dimetrodon: plates are separate rigid leaf triangles, NEVER one continuous sail. BASE cute moss-green calf with small soft leafy dorsal buds and exactly TWO blunt soft tail spikes, gentle eyes and pale muzzle. EVO1 sturdy stegosaur with large green leaf plates and FOUR distinct tail spikes. EVO2 massive fierce stegosaur with hardened terracotta autumn-leaf plates, moss patches across green back and long FOUR ivory tail spikes. MYTHICAL Jurassic herd guardian: tremendous green stegosaur, dramatic two-row crest of huge orange/terracotta forest-canopy leaf plates bearing small abstract gold runes, massive low body, FOUR huge amber tail spikes, small stern ivory beaked head and thick powerful legs. Preserve pale muzzle, leaf plates and long spiked tail through all stages. No trees standing on its back, artifacts, armor suit or aura.

palette: Cream/ivory body, sunset-red membranes, orange/gold crest, violet shadows and amber accents.
concept: Pteranodon de alas rojizas y cresta de cometa, guardián del último cielo cretácico.
design: PTERANODON prehistoric flyer with long toothless pointed BEAK, backward-swept long bony CREST, TWO large membranous wings supported by long wing fingers, two small hind legs and tiny tail. NOT a feathered bird, bat, dragon or blue cyclone pterosaur: this is cream, red and orange sunset identity with strong tapering orange head crest. BASE tiny harmless cream hatchling standing on two little feet with short folded rust-red wings, little round crest and innocent eyes, cannot fly. EVO1 young pterosaur with wings opening, longer orange crest and sharp cream beak. EVO2 fierce huge glider with broad deep-red membranous wings, pale chest, long glowing-looking orange crest and strong clawed hind feet. MYTHICAL last-sunset guardian: majestic Pteranodon with spectacular wide red/ivory wings, long orange/gold meteor-shaped CREST, amber rings integrated near wing wrists, abstract golden wing runes and a few separated gold comet chips close to body, not trailing across cells. Exactly two wings, no extra legs or teeth. Preserve ivory beak, red membranes, orange crest. All wing tips crest and feet complete.

palette: Warm chestnut and ochre wool, ivory tusks, icy blue crystals, golden amber cores and runes.
concept: Mamut lanudo de colmillos glaciares con núcleo de ámbar, guardián de la Edad de Hielo.
design: WOOLLY MAMMOTH prehistoric ice-age guardian. Big high-domed head, small rounded ears, huge high shoulder hump, long flexible trunk, TWO immense inward-curving tusks, dense shaggy chestnut wool, exactly FOUR thick columnar legs, short thin tuft tail. Distinct from tropical/forest elephant: ears SMALL, fur massive and shaggy, head dome/hump high, tusks long and curled, blue frost and stone not leaves. BASE adorable round brown woolly mammoth calf, short curled trunk, tiny ivory tusks, small ears and gentle eyes. EVO1 larger woolly young mammoth with longer coat, pale-blue frost tips and curved tusks. EVO2 fierce massive mammoth with strong rock/ice shoulder patches, long ivory tusks, high shoulder hump and heavy brown fur. MYTHICAL Ice Age time guardian: spectacular enormous woolly mammoth, two giant icy-blue/ivory curled tusks with clearly visible AMBER cores, broad rocky high shoulder hump, abstract golden forehead rune, long trunk and rich chestnut/ochre shaggy coat with pale blue frost edges. Preserve chestnut wool, curled trunk, small ears and paired curved tusks. No leaf ears, extra tusks, saddle, rider, armor suit or aura.
